text:
Olivia: Quick sync — planning Hosted API Q3/Q4. We need to pick 3 priority slices to focus engineering + PM bandwidth on: low-latency chat, embeddings SLO + cache, and rerank quality for search. Any strong opinions?
Dan: I'd prioritize low-latency chat and embeddings SLO. Rerank needs more infra/eval work before it's a top ship item.
Jane: Agree. For rerank we should define clear evaluation criteria (ndcg, recall) before committing. Can't ship blind.
Mike: From UX side, short deterministic fallbacks for chat are acceptable during canary. We should prototype the degraded response UX now.
Sam: Technically we can hit embedding p95 targets by combining KV-prefix caching + tuned batch windows. Autoscaling policies need a small config surface for customers.
Lia: Sales feedback: enterprise customers ask for embedding latency SLAs (<=50ms p95) for small queries and an ability to reserve capacity for embeddings workloads.
Olivia: Draft OKRs idea: reduce Hosted API chat p95 by 30% (globally), embeddings p95 <=50ms for small docs, and keep rerank NDCG delta within +/-1% while cost delta <=5%.
Dan: 30% p95 reduction implies kernel selection work + dynamic batching + maybe quantization on some models. We should timebox a 6-week spike.
Jane: Eval harness sketch (proposal):
```
metric: ndcg@10
baseline: model-rev-2024-05
promote_if: ndcg_delta >= -0.01 and cost_delta <= 0.05
```
This lets us gate rerank against quality + cost.
Sam: Ops requirements: we need token-level telemetry + per-model cost breakdown before any canary. Also per-route rollout controls.
Olivia: Launch criteria (working list): 1) perf targets met in canary traffic 2) no quality regressions on eval suites 3) rollback and auto-fallback policies tested 4) customer-facing docs + SDK examples updated 5) cost impact <= 5% or explicit sign-off.
Dan: Proposed timeline: 6-week tech spike (kernel/batcher/quant), 2-week canary (10% traffic, dedicated infra), 1-week rollout ramp if stable.
Lia: We'll recruit 2 customers for canary: AcmeSearch and NimbusAI — both volunteered. We'll coordinate NDAs and support.
Mike: I'll draft customer messaging + in-console banners for the canary and degraded-mode UX.
Jane: Need a labeled rerank dataset: ~50k queries with relevance labels. Ops: how do we store/evaluate?
Sam: We can use existing eval infra; need a dataset bucket + eval job config. I'll create infra ticket.
deploy-bot: Created ticket HOSTED-789: "chat-latency-kernel-spike" and HOSTED-790: "embeddings-slo-canary-config".
Olivia: Nice — I'll write slice briefs and OKR picks this afternoon and tag owners. Meeting tomorrow 10am to split tickets and confirm canary customers. :thumbsup:
